title: Label and group come back on the home page
why: Coach Milan 19 November 16:40: yes, label and group come back on the home page, as their own ticket. Found while building DT327: the home page shows ten of the twelve videos.

opportunity.from: Coach Milan, 19 November 2026, 16:40. DT327 (0.3.164) recorded the label and group videos again, two photos of two sides each, but no page shows them.
opportunity.job: As a visitor of chefmealan.com, see every way a food gets onto my plate before I join.
opportunity.kind: Missing: two ways the app has are not on the page, and the barcode way's line speaks for the label too.
opportunity.why_now: 0.3.164 has the two videos new, on the made-up packs, recorded on today's app.

problem: Since 1 November the section Start from anything shows two ways in: A barcode or a label, and A photo of your meal. The app has four: Barcode, Label, Group and Meal, the four modes of its camera. A visitor never sees a label read from two photos, or a few packs found at once. The two videos exist and are new, but no page shows them.
story: When I look at Start from anything, I want to see every way the camera reads a food, so that I know what I can scan before I join.

ac.title: Four ways in
ac.text: Given the home page, when I reach Start from anything, then I see four ways in, in the camera's order of reading a pack and then a plate: A barcode, A label, A few packs at once, A photo of your meal, each with its line and its video.

ac.title: A label
ac.text: Given the way A label, when its video plays, then it shows two photos, the front of the pack and then its nutrition table, and the food on the plate.

ac.title: A few packs at once
ac.text: Given the way A few packs at once, when its video plays, then it shows two photos, the fronts and then the backs, and three packs found, each with values read from the label.

ac.title: The words say what each video shows
ac.text: Given the four ways, when I read the lead and each way's title and line, then they are the words in the table on this board, and the barcode's line no longer speaks for the label.

ac.title: On a phone, two by two
ac.text: Given a phone, when I scroll Start from anything, then the four ways sit two by two, each video as wide as its column, and the section is no taller than it is today.

ac.title: On a computer, four in a row
ac.text: Given a computer, when I see Start from anything, then the four ways sit in one row.

ac.title: In three languages
ac.text: Given the new and changed lines, when the home page is in Serbian or German, then each shows in that language.

short: Start from anything shows four ways in again: barcode, label, a few packs at once, a photo of your meal

boardTitle: DT328: label and group come back on the home page
text: Start from anything, under the title
Scan a barcode or a nutrition label, or take a photo of the meal in front of you. Each one lands on your plate.
Scan a barcode, a nutrition label or a few packs at once, or take a photo of the meal in front of you. Each one lands on your plate.
The label gets its own way.
The pack's values, or the label read from a photo, every side if you need. You check it.
The pack's code, read by the camera. Its values come from the food database. You check them.
Two photos: the front for the name, the nutrition table for the values. You check them.
The fronts, then the backs. Each pack is found, with the values from its table.
now: Two ways in since HP3 (1 November): A barcode or a label, and A photo of your meal. On a phone one below the other, 1,382 px tall; on a computer two side by side.
proposed: Four ways in: A barcode, A label, A few packs at once, A photo of your meal. On a phone two by two (B, 1,227 px tall, a little shorter than today), on a computer four in a row. One below the other on a phone (A) would make the section 2,531 px tall, nearly twice today's. The lead and two lines get new words, four lines are new, in English, Serbian and German.
decision: Open. B drawn as the proposal, A next to it for comparison. Waits for Coach Milan's choice and Go.
details: The pictures on this board are the real page: today's 0.3.164, and a scratch build of 0.3.164 with the four ways, not committed.
On a phone in B each video is 172 px wide (today 220 px), the title 16 px, the line 13.5 px.
No new videos: label and group are the ones recorded in 0.3.164.
